source: KSQAAC Spardha Yashassu NMMS Study Material 2022, MAT Chapter 21 (questions: PDF pages 66–67, solutions: PDF pages 146–148)

questions.rule: The jumps grow: +2, +3, +4, +5, +6. After Z, count on from A.
questions.working: Y (25) + 6 = 31, and 31 − 26 = 5, which is E

questions.rule: 1st letters go forward 5 (B, G, L, Q). 2nd letters go back 5 (Y, T, O, J).
questions.working: Q + 5 = V and J − 5 = E, so VE

questions.rule: 1st letters go forward 1 (C, D, E, F). The middle letters are the vowels A, E, I, O. Last letters go back 1 (X, W, V, U).
questions.working: F + 1 = G, the vowel after O is U, and U − 1 = T, so GUT

questions.rule: Two series are mixed: C, D, E, F, G in the odd places and K, L, M, N in the even places.
questions.working: Next comes the even-place series: N + 1 = O. Then the odd-place series: G + 1 = H. So O, H

questions.rule: Each group starts 3 letters after the one before (E, H, K, N). Inside a group: the 1st letter, then +2, then +1 (E, G, F).
questions.working: Q, then Q + 2 = S, then Q + 1 = R, so QSR

questions.rule: Each word drops the first and last letters of the word before.
questions.working: VIRONME without V and E is IRONM

questions.rule: Add 3 each time.
questions.working: S + 3 = V, and V + 3 = Y

questions.rule: 1st letters go back 2 (Z, X, V, T). The numbers go up 2 (2, 4, 6, 8). Last letters go forward 3 (A, D, G, J).
questions.working: T − 2 = R, 8 + 2 = 10 and J + 3 = M, so R10M

questions.rule: Each group uses 4 letters in a row, written in the order 1st, 3rd, 4th, 2nd: A B C D becomes A C D B.
questions.working: The next 4 letters are M N O P, written M O P N

questions.rule: 1st letters go back 2 (X, V, T, R). 2nd letters go forward 2 (C, E, G, I).
questions.working: R − 2 = P and I + 2 = K, so PK

questions.rule: Add 5 each time. After Z, count on from A.
questions.working: V (22) + 5 = 27, and 27 − 26 = 1, which is A

questions.rule: 1st letters go forward 1 (K, L, M, N, O). 2nd letters go back 1 (F, E, D, C, B). 3rd letters go forward 1 (U, V, W, X, Y).
questions.working: M, D and W, so MDW
P (16) + 4 = 20, which is T

questions.rule: 1st letters go forward 2 (B, D, F, H). 2nd letters go forward 3 (C, F, I, L).
questions.working: H + 2 = J and L + 3 = O, so JO

questions.rule: 1st letters go forward 2 (B, D, F, H), 2nd letters forward 3 (D, G, J, M), 3rd letters forward 5 (F, K, P, U).
questions.working: H + 2 = J, M + 3 = P and U + 5 = Z, so JPZ
questions.note: The book's key says A (JPY), but its own worked diagram adds 5 to the last letters: F, K, P, U, then Z.

questions.rule: First numbers double (2, 4, 8, 16). Letters jump +1, +2, +3 (A, B, D, G). Last numbers go up 2, 3, 4 (10, 12, 15, 19).
The first two letters count backwards in pairs (VU, TS, RQ, PO). The last two count forwards in pairs (EF, GH, IJ, KL).
questions.working: NM, then MN, so NMMN

questions.rule: X, Y and Z stay the same. The numbers are the prime numbers in order: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23.
questions.working: The next primes are 29, 31 and 37, so X29Y31Z37
questions.note: The book's key says D (X29Y31Z33), but 33 is not a prime number (33 = 3 × 11).

questions.rule: Each group is 3 letters in a row, written 2nd, 3rd, 1st: D E F becomes E F D. The groups start at D, G, J (+3).
questions.working: The next 3 letters are M N O, written N O M

questions.rule: B stays in the middle. The outside letters come in pairs, K L then M N, and each pair is written forwards, then backwards.
questions.working: The next pair is O P, written forwards: OBP
questions.note: The book's key says C (PBO). That is the backwards form, which would come 6th, after OBP.

questions.rule: Each letter is shown with its place in the alphabet, and the letters jump by 4.
questions.working: P + 4 = T, the 20th letter, so T-20
